start.title: Sled in the Ditch
start.text: A freight sled has gone sideways off the road. One runner is snapped, sacks are scattered across the slope, and a man is pinned from the waist down beneath the frame. He is conscious enough to curse when he sees you.

choices.text: Lift the frame while he pulls free

buckets.flavourText: The frame rises just enough. He drags himself clear and immediately checks whether his legs still answer him.
You shift the weight, but not cleanly. He comes free with a cry and cannot put weight on one ankle.
The sled barely moves. The effort only settles it deeper into the drift.

leverage.title: A Better Angle
leverage.text: A broken fence post lies under the snow nearby. With it as a lever, the problem becomes less about raw force and more about choosing where to place the fulcrum.

choices.text: Set the lever and raise the sled

buckets.flavourText: The frame rises smoothly and the driver crawls free with little more than bruising.
The lever slips once, but the second attempt works.
The rotten post splits in your hands.

need_leverage.title: Too Much Weight
need_leverage.text: The driver stops cursing and starts giving terse instructions. There is an iron cargo bar lashed beneath the rear bench, if you can reach it.

choices.text: Tell him you cannot spare more time

rescued.title: Freight and Gratitude
rescued.text: The driver sits in the snow flexing both knees. He offers you first choice from a torn sack: dried onions, lamp wicks, or a small packet of bitter tea. "Take one before the road takes all of it," he says.

choices.text: Accept a small share and help right the cargo

injured.title: A Limp Home
injured.text: His ankle is swelling, but he can stand with the sled rail as a crutch. The cargo will have to wait. He asks only that you walk with him until the first roofs are visible.

leave.title: A Voice Behind You
leave.text: You leave the ditch behind. For a while you can still hear him shouting for anyone on the road. Then the wind takes the sound.
